game.name: Batman Arkham Origins (Brazil)(En,Es,Pt)(Disco 2)
game.desc: Batman: Arkham Origins plunges us into an even bigger Gotham City and an all-new story set several years before the events of Batman: Arkham Asylum and Batman: Arkham City. Set long before the arrival of Gotham City's most dangerous criminals, the game introduces us to the young, raw and inexperienced Batman. As he begins his fight against evil, he will have to make a decisive choice that will lead him to become the Dark Knight. As the story progresses, the player will meet key characters and develop crucial relationships. Batman's detective skills will also be put to the test thanks to an all-new system that allows players to comb crime scenes for crucial clues.
